Druddigon

Dragon

Unova · Generation 5

Druddigon is a Dragon-type Cave Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 1.6 m tall and weighs 139 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Attack (120), with a base stat total of 485.
